SKETCH v1 is posted on STORY-1888 (aida show STORY-1888 --comments).
1. protected_paths under [mandate.human_gates] can only tighten: the result is floor ∪ origin/main ∪ ~/.aida, each entry carries its source, a malformed entry fails closed, and an unreadable layer still checks the floor. 2. A ratchet test (marker OR authority-name regex) puts a grandfather list of today's unprotected gate code (role.rs, pr_cmd.rs, lib_part5.rs and others) inside the floor; that list may only shrink.
3 questions: Q1 should a non-mandate agent `aida pr ship` of protected paths be refused, as a separate PR 2? Q2 grandfather list, or put those files on the floor now? Q3 regex+marker, or marker only? No code is written yet; I'm waiting for signoff.
subject: SKETCH posted (STORY-1888)
